subject: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@orbitcare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Pain points you shared:
- High tail latency on model endpoints during peak clinical inference windows (8–10am PT).
- Regulatory requirement to keep PHI isolated in a private environment.
- Need predictable throughput for batch nightly processing and real-time inference for triage workflows.

Goals we discussed:
- Dedicated GPU pools (reserved) to guarantee throughput for production workloads.
- VPC private deployment for data isolation and KMS integration.
- SLA target: 99.9% uptime with p95 latency under 200ms for short requests (<256 tokens).

Redwood Dedicated recap (what we recommend):
- Reserved capacity: 4x A100-class GPU nodes reserved (scale plan below).
- Isolation: Private deployment in your VPC with customer-managed subnets + KMS/HSM for keys.
- Scaling plan: Baseline 4 nodes, autoscale +2 nodes for predictable burst capacity (can be configured as warm pool).
- Observability: Per-route latency/cost dashboards and alerts; token-level cost breakdowns.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 artifacts + network diagrams (we’ll share evidence pack on request).

Immediate next steps:
1) I’ll put together a mutual action plan (MAP) and a dedicated-capacity quote (attached).
2) Please confirm isolation requirements (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink) and whether you need air-gapped on-prem in future.
3) If that looks good, we’ll schedule a technical kick-off with infra and security to gather network requirements.

Attachments: OrbitCare_MAP.pdf (MAP), redwood-dedicated-quote.pdf (initial quote)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a shared HubSpot deal and calendar invite for the kick-off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@orbitcare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@orbitcare.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Isolation: We need full VPC deployment with customer-managed subnets and PrivateLink to avoid internet egress for PHI. Peering is OK but PrivateLink preferred.
- SLA: The 99.9% target is good. For p95 latency, can you confirm what is achievable with the 4-node baseline vs. with +2 burst capacity? We will need numbers to include in our internal SRE review.
- Nightly batch: Our peak batch windows are 02:00–04:00 PT and can spike by 1.5–2x for experimental runs.

Next steps from us:
- I’ll get our network team to review the MAP and provide a contact for the kick-off (likely me + Priya + our infra lead).
- We’re targeting a procurement approval by end of May if terms/quote look reasonable.

Please send the technical pack and any perf numbers you can share for similar deployments.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
CTO, OrbitCare
alex.j@orbitcare.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Alex —

Appreciate the fast response. Quick answers and some additional detail attached.

Isolation: We’ll plan for a PrivateLink deployment by default (we’ll capture exact CIDR and subnet details in the kick-off).

Performance: For short requests (<256 tokens) on a 4-node baseline we typically observe p95 latencies between 110–180ms depending on model topology and KV cache hit rate. With +2 burst nodes warmed (warm pool), p95 is typically 90–130ms. I attached a short perf summary from a comparable healthcare customer (anonymized).

Batch windows: The +2 burst capacity should cover 1.5–2x nightly spikes if configured as warm pool. If you expect sustained 2x baseline regularly, we should size baseline to 6 nodes — happy to model cost with your expected token volumes.

Attachments: OrbitCare_MAP.pdf (mutual action plan outlining responsibilities and timelines), redwood-dedicated-quote.pdf (itemized quote w/ reserved pricing and add-on for PrivateLink).

Proposed immediate timeline:
- 5/13: kick-off call (network + security + infra) — Marissa / Aditya / Alex / Priya / OrbitCare infra lead
- 5/14–5/18: network artifacts and SSO/KMS requirements collected
- 5/20: final quote + SOW draft

Do you want me to include an initial SOW draft in the 5/20 deliverable? We can fast-follow if procurement needs a draft earlier.

Thanks,
Marissa
